data_preferences.name: Capex and ROI metrics (Revenue/Capex ratio, ARR)
data_preferences.description: Used to validate the commercial viability of AI infrastructure investments and determine when the market shifts from narrative-driven to earnings-driven.

evidence.quote: 最值得盯隐藏指标：“营收/Capex比值”衡量折旧拐点的核心指标，FY25约4.0；
SemiAnalysis披露Anthropic的年化收入ARR已经突破440亿美元
质疑这么大的算力投入能不能算过账，未来的营收利润能不能cover这么大的资本开支

data_preferences.name: Order Backlogs / Remaining Performance Obligations (RPO)
data_preferences.description: Monitors RPO QoQ growth and contract duration to verify whether real demand from hyperscalers and enterprises matches capital expenditure claims.

evidence.quote: 本季重点盯RPO环比增长（大概率+20-25%）和加权平均剩余期限（延长至5年以上 = 长合约时代确认）。
一季度谷歌云4600亿美金的未履约订单，估计一半以都是预订TPU的算力。

data_preferences.name: CTA (Commodity Trading Advisor) Fund Flows
data_preferences.description: Tracks mechanical/passive buy-and-sell momentum signals via Goldman Sachs models to identify short-term market reversals or exhaustion.

evidence.quote: 高盛模型显示CTA“买入燃料已耗尽”转为潜在卖方，尤其在中线下行情景下压力更大。
上周CTA已买入约190亿美元美股，当前CTA在标普500上仍持有约300亿美元空仓，本周预计的买入将平掉这些空仓并翻多

data_preferences.name: Regulatory & Legal Rulings (SEC / CFTC)
data_preferences.description: Tracks legislative developments (e.g., Clarity Act, SEC Safe Harbors) to predict structural shifts in the crypto industry, such as RWA tokenization and stablecoin compliance.

evidence.quote: SEC交易与市场部发布的一份员工声明
SEC创新豁免是证券代币化的“催化剂”，将加速传统金融从上世纪传统架构迁移至区块链账上的链上时代

analytical_process.description: Identify physical bottlenecks or structural limits in a high-growth sector.

evidence.quote: 半导体产业链（尤其是AI算力领域）的瓶颈演变，正是从“计算（GPU）→存储（HBM等）→光互连→电力/液冷”这一清晰的顺序递进的。

凡是致力于“让两个人类更好地踢皮球、走流程”的纯软件公司，其终局都不会很好。

veto_rules.rule: Avoid holding pure human-workflow software companies during the AI supercycle.
veto_rules.rationale: AI coding and autonomous agents easily replace software built primarily for human-to-human interaction or process management without a hardware or data moat.

evidence.quote: 凡是致力于“让两个人类更好地踢皮球、走流程”的纯软件公司，其终局都不会很好。

veto_rules.rule: Do not bet on broad 'altcoin seasons' (鸡犬升天) based on narrative alone.
veto_rules.rationale: The crypto market has matured and polarized into an 'effective market' (New Normal), where liquidity concentrates strictly in assets with fundamental utility, deep liquidity, or RWA backing, bypassing weak narratives.

evidence.quote: 大家以前想象的山寨季是鸡犬升天，实际上未来山寨季可能只限于那些主线叙事逻辑板块的龙头，然后大部分小币可能就是一波流
市场越成熟越有效，分化就越严重

falsifiability_rules.thesis: High growth of AI cloud revenues is sustainable.
falsifiability_rules.falsifier: If Cloud providers' Deferred Revenue + RPO (Remaining Performance Obligations) QoQ growth drops below 8%.

evidence.quote: 可证伪判断：如果谷歌财报给出的"递延收入 + RPO 季度环比增速"低于 8%，则GCP58%整体增速的可持续性可能会被证伪

falsifiability_rules.thesis: AI Infrastructure capacity build-out is generating positive ROI against depreciation.
falsifiability_rules.falsifier: If the Revenue to Capex ratio of major cloud providers falls below 3.5.
